part.text:
Implemented incremental builds and caching for the SSG.

**New files**
- `src/cache.ts` — `.ssg-cache.json` manifest with SHA-256 source hashes, global template hash (all `.hbs` under templates dir, incl. layouts/partials), cached frontmatter, rendered HTML, and `BuildStats`.
- `test/incremental.test.ts` — 17 tests covering incremental correctness.

**Changed files**
- `src/core.ts` — `SSGEngine.build()` now decides dirty/clean pages per page (source hash + template hash match → skip; restore `data`/`body`/`html`/`templated` from cache), skips writes for untouched output files, prunes removed-page entries, rewrites the manifest, and reports `stats` (built, skipped, elapsed, time saved).
- `src/build.ts` — `buildSite(..., { incremental, clean })`; `SiteBuildResult.stats`.
- `src/cli.ts` — `--incremental` and `--clean` flags, help text, and an incremental stats line (e.g. `Incremental build: 1 built, 1 skipped, ~8ms saved`).
- `src/server.ts` — dev-server rebuilds now use incremental mode (template changes still invalidate everything via the template hash).
- `src/index.ts` — exports cache module + `BuildStats`.

Clean build happens automatically when the cache is missing/corrupt or when `--clean` is passed; plugin architecture and existing behavior are untouched (all original 83 tests still pass).
